description: Generate a WhatsApp click-to-chat wa.me link with an international number and optional pre-filled message — no contact save needed.

faqs.a: Yes — wa.me is WhatsApp's official click-to-chat domain. The link opens a chat with that number even if it is not in your contacts.
faqs.q: Is wa.me an official WhatsApp link?

faqs.a: Enter the full international number: country code + number, digits only, no +, spaces or dashes.
faqs.q: What number format does it need?

faqs.a: The message is percent-encoded with encodeURIComponent, so emojis, line breaks and special characters all work.
faqs.q: Can the pre-filled message include emojis?

faqs.a: Fully — the link is built locally in your browser.

howto: Enter the phone number in international format (country code + number, digits only).
Copy the wa.me link or click Open chat to test it.
